A '''''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle''' was docked aboard a [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] that the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] loaned to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], as his [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] for an [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|assault]] on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was stolen by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] when they escaped from Bane's [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]].<ref name="COD" />
